claims.statement: Bavelas 1948 A Mathematical Model for Group Structures began formal study of communication structure
Leavitt MIT 1949 dissertation and 1951 journal article are distinct publications
Experimental centrality outcomes were heterogeneous and not a universal leadership guarantee
Degree C=k/(n-1), closeness=(n-1)/sum shortest distances and betweenness shortest-path fractions are different centralities
Nine-node K4-X-K4 graph has degrees A=B=4 X=2; distance sums A=B=15 X=14; betweenness A=B=15 X=16
claims.locator: chapter's original graph, can independently enumerate 9 vertices

claims.statement: Freeman 1977 published a set of measures based on betweenness
Katz 1953 status index accounts for who chooses as well as how many and attenuation
Katz-type resolvent requires alpha under reciprocal spectral radius for convergence; matrix direction must match in/out choice
claims.locator: modern linear algebra exposition; not verbatim original notation

claims.statement: Freeman 1978-79 distinguishes degree, closeness, betweenness and vertex centrality vs network centralization
Network centrality is structural, not direct measurement of worth or causal influence
